name: Rocks to Rests

angles.text: Helping young orcs behind the Warchief's stronghold shows how community and everyday life matter in Orgrimmar, even in a warrior society.
Orc youths making games behind Grommash Hold show how the next generation grows up in the heart of Durotar.

faq.answer: Thra is a young orc playing games with friends in the clearing behind Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. Thra is observant and playful, and asks passersby to help improve the play area.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Rocks to Rests?

faq.answer: The clearing lies directly behind Grommash Hold, Warchief Thrall's seat in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom. The children gather in this relatively clear patch of dirt, away from the fortress's heavy traffic.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

faq.answer: Thra and the other youths need smooth, medium-sized rocks for chairs and tables. Without furniture, they sit in the dirt while arranging and playing their miniature games.
faq.q: Why does Thra need smooth boulders?

faq.answer: Thra and the other youths play an informal tabletop game with small figures spread across the ground. The smooth boulders will give them steady places for their figures and somewhere comfortable to sit.
faq.q: What game is being played behind Grommash Hold?

faq.answer: No. This is a peaceful undertaking, with no fighting or military trial. You use your strength to haul heavy boulders to the children's game spot.
faq.q: Does Rocks to Rests involve fighting?

aliases: what happens after rocks to rests
what does thra do with rocks
faq.answer: After you deliver the eight smooth boulders, Thra and the children move them around the clearing. Their flat sides make seats and tables for the figures in their tabletop game.
faq.q: What do the children do with the boulders once delivered?

sections.body: Young orcs gather in a dirt clearing behind Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. There they can play away from the fortress guards. The open ground suits their miniature figures, but with no furniture, they sit in the dust.
sections.title: A Quiet Corner of Orgrimmar

sections.body: Thra spots you passing and asks you to carry eight medium-sized, smooth boulders to the clearing. Their flat sides will make sturdy chairs and low tables. Then the youths can arrange their games without sitting in the dirt.
sections.title: Makeshift Furniture

summary: Behind Grommash Hold, Thra and friends make room for games in Orgrimmar. They need smooth boulders to use as chairs and tables.
attribution: In-game quest text: Rocks to Rests
